info.title: ASI Project API
info.description:
The Attack Surface Intelligence (ASI) Project API is designed to allow you full-featured access
to all of the `Assets` within all of the `Project`s as well as , most importantly, the `Exposures` that our
system has identified on those assets, including proposed remediations.

You can create new user-defined `Tags` and apply them to `Assets` either individually or in bulk.

You can use either the GET-based listing endpoint to find assets or the /_search endpoint which
accepts a more structured request and, in the future, will allow for even more complex boolean queries.

Using it only requires a standard Security Trails API access key.

info.title: ASI Project API
info.description:
The Attack Surface Intelligence (ASI) Project API is designed to allow you full-featured access
to all of the `Assets` within all of the `Project`s as well as , most importantly, the `Exposures` that our
system has identified on those assets, including proposed remediations.

You can create new user-defined `Tags` and apply them to `Assets` either individually or in bulk.

You can use either the GET-based listing endpoint to find assets or the /_search endpoint which
accepts a more structured request and, in the future, will allow for even more complex boolean queries.

Using it only requires a standard Security Trails API access key.

info.description:
The Attack Surface Intelligence (ASI) Project API is designed to allow you full-featured access
to all of the `Assets` within all of the `Project`s as well as , most importantly, the `Exposures` that our

You can use either the GET-based listing endpoint to find assets or the /_search endpoint which
accepts a more structured request and, in the future, will allow for even more complex boolean queries.

Using it only requires a standard Security Trails API access key.
